name: Network Aviation (blue)
description: Network Aviation Group's paint on Air Atlanta Icelandic 747-400 freighters: white, a large light-grey 'Network' in plain semibold lowercase (capital N) over the forward main deck, and a royal-blue aft fuselage behind a diagonal rising from the belly under the wing's trailing edge to the fin's root. The blue fin carries a big stylised white eagle's head facing forward (its beak toward the leading edge, two blue feather streaks across it, a blue disc bitten out of its lower front) that runs off the trailing edge. A small 'Network' with its square logo and 'Airline Management' sits just ahead of and on the blue. White engines; blue winglets with the white eagle.

Fitted to shapes/B744.json (doors pinned; ~0.7 m aft bias at the doors, taken out): the diagonal's edge, the fin's eagle, the titles' ends and heights, the blue winglet.

areas.name: royal-blue aft fuselage behind a diagonal from the belly (under the wing's trailing edge) to the fin's root

titles.style: Plain semibold sans, capital N and lowercase, upright, light grey, over the main deck from just behind door 1 to about two thirds of the way to the wing; the same stretch on the right.
Small grey semibold 'Network' behind its square logo, on the white just ahead of the blue (its last letter reaching the blue); followed by a thin bar and 'Airline Management'.
Small white text on the blue, the upper of two lines after 'Network |'.
Small white text on the blue, the lower line.
On the right the group reads logo, 'Network', bar, 'Airline Management' from the tail forward: 'Network' in white italic on the blue, ahead of the logo.
Small dark text on the white ahead of the blue, the upper line.
Small dark text on the white, the lower line.

logos.description: Network's small square logo ahead of the aft 'Network': a blue square with white curved speed lines.
The same square on the right, aft of 'Network', on the blue.

The eagle's white head on the blue fin, beak forward, a blue streak and a feather notch across it; it runs off the trailing edge (the fin's outline crops it there) and down past the root, a blue disc bitten from its lower front.
The fin's eagle head small and white on each blue winglet, beak forward.

notes: Flown by Air Atlanta Icelandic (ABD) for Network Aviation Group (Network Airline Management); tagged per airframe in airframes/ABD.json (TF-AMM, TF-AMU). The blue tail and aft fuselage with the eagle predate the Network titles: TF-AMU (2020-04-08) and TF-AMM (2023-04-30) carried them under ASTRAL titles. The tail's eagle is drawn as fin areas, measured on TF-AMU; its proposed simplified mark is ABD/network-eagle (used on the winglets). Measured on the left (TF-AMU, a factory 747-400ERF with the short upper deck) and checked on the right (TF-AMM, a converted 747-400BDSF with the long one): the main title runs about 12.4-25.8 m back on both sides, cap height ~1.1 m; the blue's edge is at ~45 m at the belly, ~51 m at the window line, ~54-55 m at the crown. The aft small titles are a few tenths of a metre tall and partly by eye; the right side's 'Network' may be grey where it sits on white. A small 'Operated by Air Atlanta Icelandic' by door 1 is not drawn. Colours by eye.
history: New in the LAX round (2026-11-20); Air Atlanta Icelandic's customer paint, not drawn before.
